root_cause.summary: In workflow Branch CI Gate (run 37799866634), job 'Smoke acceptance' failed during step 'Run source ingestion tests' on test services/source_ingestion/tests/test_multi_process_source_reconciliation.py::test_two_process_workers_create_one_connector_schedule_run_and_source_record. Two spawned worker processes concurrently imported services.source_ingestion.main, each executing DistillationJobQueue._bootstrap() on the same SQLite data_dir. At line 377 of distillation_worker.py, connection.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL') raised sqlite3.OperationalError: database is locked due to exclusive lock contention between concurrent processes attempting to switch SQLite journal modes simultaneously. The test failure is an intermittent concurrency flake in the test suite and completely unrelated to the changes in PR #6426 (which only refactored bounded response reader helpers in source connectors).
